Hi Dana —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We want to lock Day 0 (kickoff) so we can align owners and complete preflight items. A few quick asks so we can confirm the calendar: 

1) Please confirm final attendee list (Role + email) using the attached Week0-attendee-template.csv.

   - 11:00–12:30 PT (90m) — better for East Coast stakeholders
   - 14:00–15:00 PT (60m) — condensed agenda if you need shorter

Attached: SSO-onboarding-instructions.pdf (short checklist) and attendee template. If you can also send the ACME SAML metadata, that saves time during the SSO breakout.

- 0:30–0:55 — SSO / network preflight (Marcus) — breakout if needed
- 0:55–1:15 — Product enablement + success metrics (Marissa)

- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999111222
- Google Meet / calendar invite will be sent once we lock time.

Thanks — if you confirm a time and upload the attendee CSV, I’ll send the final calendar with section owners and the join kit.
